project.name: Seigyo and MyShop
project.type: Agent-native incident recovery and causal commerce environment
project.audience: Incident commanders, SREs, engineering leaders, WebMCP judges, and storefront customers
project.stack: React 19, Vite, Tailwind 4, Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects
assumptions: Black Vector is the chosen direction.
MyShop remains a believable independent dark retail experience.

topRecommendations: Use beUI agent patterns as adapted source, not as an unchanged visual kit.
Use Radix and shadcn for accessible behavior.
Use Carbon dark layering and Primer chart rules.
Keep Seigyo connected and operational; keep MyShop image-led and editorial.
